host_quote: Jim Garrity, we're going to Maine. We're Troy Jackson. Not in all polling, but pretty consistently leading by a couple over Sue Collins, as MBD calls her. Who's winning in Maine?
resolution_criteria: The candidate who wins the 2026 Maine US Senate general election, after ranked-choice tabulation if no candidate has a first-round majority. Decided by the Associated Press's call. If AP has not called it within 60 days of election day, the certified official result decides. Resolves when the race is called.
outcome_source_title: WMTW: AP calls Maine Senate race for Troy Jackson after Sen. Susan Collins concedes
